svg.title: Decay of phosphorus-32 and sulfur-35 labels on linear and logarithmic axes
svg.desc: Left: fraction of activity remaining over 180 days on a linear axis. Phosphorus-32, half-life 14.3 days, falls to one half at 14.3 days and is nearly gone by 100 days; sulfur-35, half-life 87.4 days, falls to one half at 87.4 days. Right: the same curves on a logarithmic axis are straight lines whose slopes are minus the decay constants; each halving takes one half-life.
svg.text: First-order decay of two classic labels
Every half-life halves what is left: after n half-lives a fraction (½)ⁿ remains, whatever the starting amount.
